Claims Lifecycle

How a claim moves through

Real-time claim review, specialty-specific coding expertise, and payer knowledge across all 50 states and all specialties.

Step 01 of 05

Charge Capture & Claim Scrubbing

Missing modifiers, invalid codes, and credentialing mismatches cause most denials before a claim ever reaches a payer. Our AAPC-certified coders review every claim against payer-specific rules, specialty billing guidelines, and documentation requirements before submission, so your first-pass paid rate goes up and your team stops chasing avoidable rejections.

  • Rules-Based Pre-ScrubbingOur certified coders review every claim against payer rules before submission.
  • Specialty Coding AuditAAPC-certified review against specialty billing guidelines and documentation requirements.
99% Clean Claim Rate
Explore Scrubbing Engine

Step 02 of 05

Denial Management & Prevention

Our specialty billing teams analyze denials by payer, code, and provider to identify root causes before they become recurring patterns. Our certified billers review documentation, correction requirements, and payer-specific processes so preventable revenue loss can be reduced going forward.

  • Root Cause ReviewSpecialty billing teams analyze denials by payer, code, and provider.
  • Prevention FocusCertified billers review documentation and payer-specific processes to reduce repeat denials.
97% First-Pass Acceptance
Explore Denial Workflow

Step 03 of 05

Expert Follow-Up & Resolution

Every outstanding claim is worked by a dedicated billing specialist with specialty-specific payer knowledge. Routine follow-up is handled systematically. Complex cases including secondary payers, payer disputes, underpayments, and coordination of benefits issues are escalated to senior specialists.

  • Dedicated Follow-UpEvery outstanding claim is worked by a dedicated billing specialist.
  • Complex Case EscalationSecondary payers, disputes, underpayments, and COB issues go to senior specialists.
2.7M+ Claims Processed
Explore Follow-Up

Step 04 of 05

Payment Posting & Reconciliation

ERA and EOB payments are reconciled daily by our payment posting team. Variances between billed amounts, contracted rates, and received payments are reviewed and addressed. Payments are posted, verified, and reconciled so financial records stay accurate and discrepancies can be identified quickly.

  • Daily ReconciliationERA and EOB payments are reconciled daily by our payment posting team.
  • Variance ReviewVariances between billed amounts, contracted rates, and received payments are reviewed.
+30% Revenue Increase Avg
Explore Payment Posting

Step 05 of 05

Real-Time Practice Reporting

A connected view of your entire revenue cycle end to end. Every step feeds the next, and every dollar is tracked from the moment a claim is created to the moment it is paid and reconciled. The PMEX reporting platform gives you visibility at every stage so you can understand where your revenue stands.

  • End-to-End VisibilityEvery dollar is tracked from claim creation through payment and reconciliation.
  • PMEX Reporting PlatformReal-time reporting updated by the PMEX billing team at every stage.
